answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a lantern for consensus, requiring agents to bond onyx collateral to validate state transitions. By tethering identity to capital, the network forces an attacker to acquire a marble fraction of the total supply to gain influence. This economic barrier makes flooding the system with fake identities prohibitively expensive, as each sybil entity demands an equivalent stake, rendering mass identity generation a net-negative financial strategy for any malicious actor.
